record.question: Under Section 2(y) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, who is a "victim"?
options: Only a person who has suffered physical injury due to the commission of an offence.
Only the complainant in a criminal case.
Any witness examined during the trial.
A person who has suffered any loss or injury caused by reason of the act or omission for which the accused person has been charged, and includes the victim's guardian or legal heir.
